full_judgment:
7. From Annexure-B it appears that the respondent No.3 being the Chief Election Commissioner vide Memo No. সসেঅদ/বাজাবস/নিপাদি-২০০১২/০৬/১২  dated 7-5-2012 had declared the election schedule fixing 8-5-2012 for publication of draft electoral roll. 12-5-2012 had been fixed for publication of final electoral roll; 13-5-2012 to 15-5-2012 had been fixed for submission of nomination papers; 16- 5-2012 had been fixed for scrutinization of the nomination papers and amongst others had fixed 2-6- 2012 for holding election of the Executive Council for 2012-2015. vide Annexure-D it appears that on 12-5-2012 final voter list had been duly published by the Election Commission. The petitioner submitted nomination paper on 15-5-2012 (Annexure-F) for contesting the post of President. It also appears from Annexure-G that respondent No.3 vide notice dated 15-5-2012 had fixed 16-5-2012 for scrutinization of the nomination papers of the contesting candidates. 

 15. So far the complaint dated 14-5-2012 (Annexure-I to the affidavit-in-opposition) pursuant to which the finally published voter list (Annexure- D) had appears to have been cancelled the respondents in this regard have categorically failed to show that any inquiry till date has been held to find any basis to the allegation so made therein.
